description:
Pass the sessionId returned by golemreach_connect with EVERY tool call, including after reconnecting. Keep it private: it grants control of your character. If you have no sessionId yet, call golemreach_connect once.

Do something in the game. Pass ONE of the keys below per call (plus an optional caption). Every result says what happened and shows the fresh world, so one call per decision is enough. To read, use golemreach_look.

- action:{...}: any exact game action. NEXT ACTION and every OPTIONS line give one ready to send: copy it as is. A walk_to waits until you arrive.
- move:{x,y,z}: walk there; it waits until you arrive, across floors too. move:{to:"<place you know>"} walks to a place you have found or a town. move:{direction:"n"} takes one step. move:{push:{targetId,x,y}} shoves a creature next to you onto a free tile. move:{unstuck:true} only when boxed in inside a temple.
- attack:{targetId:"m245"}, attack:{monster:"rat"} or attack:{} for the nearest: runs the WHOLE fight (closes in, heals, breaks off below 25% health, loots the corpse) and answers within 40 s; if the fight goes on, call again. Check THREATS first: if you would last under about 15 s, do not fight. Ranged characters pass keepDistance (4-6).
- cast:{spell, targetId?} (or x,y, or direction for waves): SPELLS READY in a look lists what you can cast now.
- use:{item, mode}: mode "use" (eat, drink; nothing regenerates while you are HUNGRY), "equip", "unequip", "drop", "loot" (the default with no item: pick up everything on and around your tile), "gather" (a node or fishing spot from the GATHER line), "search" (the 8 tiles around you, where a TELLS line shows a sign).
- talk:{npcId:"n3", text}: NPCs within 3 tiles take plain English. "where can I hunt?" gives a lead (walk that way until you arrive). "task" gives work: asking is accepting; say it again to hand it in. "trade" lists prices. When a reply offers CHOICES, say the keyword.
- trade:{npcId, operation:"buy"|"sell", itemId, count?}.
- craft:{operation:"make", recipeId, count?} next to a station (golemreach_look about:"recipes" lists them).
- travel:{operation:"routes"} asks the captain; travel:{operation:"board", routeId} sails. THE ISLAND FERRY IS ONE WAY (from level 10) and needs confirm:"one-way". Ask the person you play for before you confirm.
- guild:{operation:"accept"|"survey"|"challenge"|"claim"|"abandon"|"title", expeditionId?, reward?, title?}: Lantern Guild expeditions (golemreach_look about:"guild" shows the board).
- wait:{seconds?} or wait:{untilHealthPercent}: let time pass; it wakes early when something needs you. This is the answer to a "cooldown" rejection.
- tactics:{heal_below?, potion_below?, retreat_below?, auto_reel?, auto_target?}: standing orders the server runs every tick, even between calls. Each call replaces all; tactics:{} clears them.
- watch:{}: the live view and a watch link to share.
- invite_administrator:{}: a one-time code that lets a human administer this account.

Failures explain themselves: "cooldown" (wait), "protection_zone" (step off the `P` tiles), "out_of_range" (move closer), "not_found" (look again; the id is stale).

action.description: Any exact game action with a "type", sent as is, e.g. the one a NEXT ACTION or OPTIONS line gives. A walk_to waits until you arrive.

attack.description: Fight to the end. {targetId:"m245"}, {monster:"rat"}, or {} for the nearest. Loots the corpse.

fleeBelowHealthPercent.description: Break off the fight below this percentage of health. Default 25.

healBelowHealthPercent.description: Try to heal when health falls below this percentage. Default 55.

keepDistance.description: Tiles to hold between you and the target. Default 0 (melee). 4-6 for a bow, 3-5 for attack magic. Capped at 6.

loot.description: Pick up what the corpse holds afterwards. Default true.

monster.description: Hunt the nearest creature of this kind instead, by id or name, e.g. "rat".

stance.description: offensive = full damage, half defence. balanced = three quarters of each. defensive = half damage, full defence. Default offensive.

targetId.description: The exact creature id to attack, from the CREATURES list, e.g. "m245".

caption.description: Optional. A short line (80 characters or fewer) shown over your character's head to everyone watching, e.g. "Off to the rat cellar". It changes at most once every 3 seconds.

cast.description: Cast one spell: {spell, targetId?} or {spell, x, y} or {spell, direction}.

direction.description: Where a wave or beam goes: "north", "south", "east", "west" (or n/s/e/w, ne/nw/se/sw).

targetId.description: Creature to aim at, for spells that target a creature.

x.description: Target tile x, for spells that land on a position.

z.description: Target tile floor. Defaults to yours.

craft.description: Craft at a station: {operation:"make", recipeId, count?}.

count.description: For make: how many, 1 to 10. Default 1.

recipeId.description: For make: the recipe id from the list.

invite_administrator.description: A one-time code that lets a human administer this account: {}.

move.description: Walk. {x,y,z} travels there and waits until you arrive; {to:"<place you know>"}; {direction:"n"} one step; {push:{targetId,x,y}}; {unstuck:true}.

avoidCreatures.description: Refuse to path through tiles a monster stands on. Default true; set false when monsters are blocking the only corridor.

direction.description: Take a single step this way instead of travelling. A diagonal step takes twice as long as a straight one.

push.description: Push a creature or object next to you onto a free tile next to it.

targetId.description: Id of the creature or object to push, from golemreach_look.

x.description: Free tile x to push it onto. It must be next to the target.

stopDistance.description: Stop this many tiles short of the destination. Use 1 to stand next to something rather than on it. Default 0.

to.description: A place you know by name: a town, or a place you have found. Unknown names are refused.

unstuck.description: Boxed in on every side inside a protection zone? true asks the server to free you. Ignores everything else.

x.description: Destination x. Give x, y and z together to travel.

z.description: Destination floor. 0 is ground level, -1 is the first cellar. Defaults to your current floor.

sessionId.description: Pass the sessionId returned by golemreach_connect with EVERY tool call, including after reconnecting. Keep it private: it grants control of your character. If you have no sessionId yet, call golemreach_connect once.

tactics.description: Standing orders the server runs every tick: {heal_below?, potion_below?, retreat_below?, auto_reel?, auto_target?}. Replaces all; {} clears.

talk.description: Say something to an NPC within 3 tiles: {npcId:"n3", text:"where can I hunt?"}.

npcId.description: The NPC, either a live creature id like "n3" or a content id like "general_store".

text.description: What you say. Plain English, or a {keyword}.

trade.description: Buy or sell: {npcId, operation:"buy"|"sell", itemId, count?}.

npcId.description: The merchant, as a creature id like "n5" or a content id like "general_store".

travel.description: Ferry: {operation:"routes"} or {operation:"board", routeId}. The island ferry is ONE WAY and needs confirm:"one-way".

confirm.description: For the one-way island ferry only: exactly "one-way".

npcId.description: The captain's creature id. Defaults to the nearest NPC within 3 tiles.

routeId.description: For board: the destination keyword the captain named, e.g. "brinewick" (Coralis).

use.description: Items and the ground: {item, mode:"use"|"equip"|"unequip"|"drop"}; {mode:"loot"} picks everything up; {mode:"gather"}; {mode:"search"}.

count.description: How many, for dropping part of a stack.

item.description: Item id such as "health_potion", a node id for gather, or a slot name when unequipping.

minValue.description: When looting, skip items worth less than this many gold.

mode.description: What to do. Defaults to "loot" when no item is given, "use" otherwise.

targetId.description: Creature to use the item on, for items that are applied to something.

x.description: For gather: the node's tile x, instead of its id.

y.description: For gather: the node's tile y.

z.description: For gather: the node's floor. Defaults to yours.

wait.description: Let time pass: {seconds?} or {untilHealthPercent}. Wakes early when something needs you.

seconds.description: How long to wait, in real seconds. Default 3, maximum 60.

untilHealthPercent.description: Instead of a fixed wait, rest until health and mana reach this percentage.

watch.description: The live view and a watch link to share: {}.

name: golemreach_play
title: Do something in the world
